desc:
🚪 STEAL A DOOR! 🚪  admin abuse every day 18h paris time
Sneak into guarded zones, grab a mysterious DOOR and run back to your base before the giant guardian catches you!

Place your door in your pen and watch it OPEN: something knocks from the other side... then a creature steps out of the portal! Each creature earns you money every second.

🗺️ 11 zones: Forest, Rock, Snow, Jungle, Desert, Volcano, Abyss Ocean, Prehistoric, Cosmic, the Backrooms and the Haunted Camp
👹 A giant guardian in every zone - don’t get caught!
✨ 109 creatures to collect, from Common to Divine, Eternal and Secret
🌙 Special Night, Halloween and Limited doors
🏃 Train on treadmills to run faster and reach rarer zones
📖 Complete the Index, fuse your creatures, rebirth for bigger boosts
⚡ Admin Abuse events with crazy doors!

Steal, open, collect and become the richest door thief!
